legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.intro: These terms govern your use of AFVAR, a browser-based workspace for market analysis and education operated by RedPhantom Tech Novelty Private Limited.
legal.terms.s1.heading: What AFVAR is
legal.terms.s1.body: AFVAR provides market data, analysis and educational content. It does not execute, route or manage trades, and nothing in AFVAR is an instruction to trade.
legal.terms.s2.heading: Your account
legal.terms.s2.body: Keep your password and app PIN private. You are responsible for activity on your account. You must be 18 or older to use AFVAR.
legal.terms.s3.heading: Plans and payments
legal.terms.s3.body: Free and Pro plans are described on the pricing page. Pro renews until cancelled; cancelling keeps Pro until the end of the paid period.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This policy explains what AFVAR collects, why, and the choices you have.
legal.privacy.s1.heading: What we collect
legal.privacy.s1.body: Account details, your preferences, usage of AI features, and — only if you connect one — read-only broker data. Investor passwords are never stored.
legal.privacy.s2.heading: How we use it
legal.privacy.s2.body: To run your workspace, enforce plan limits, improve the analyst and keep your account secure. Personal data is never monetised, and AFVAR shows no ads.
legal.privacy.s3.heading: Your choices
legal.privacy.s3.body: Export or delete your data any time from Settings → Danger zone.
legal.risk.title: Risk Disclaimer
legal.risk.intro: Trading commodities, forex and cryptocurrencies carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for everyone.
legal.risk.s1.heading: Analysis and education only
legal.risk.s1.body: AFVAR provides analysis and education only. It is not investment advice and it never trades on your behalf.
legal.risk.s2.heading: No guarantees
legal.risk.s2.body: Past performance, including the public track record, does not guarantee future results. Verdicts can be wrong.
legal.risk.s3.heading: Your decisions
legal.risk.s3.body: Every trading decision is yours. Consider your objectives and risk tolerance, and seek independent advice if needed.
